app.name: Ticker-Tracker
app.disclaimer: Market data provided via Yahoo Finance. Quotes may be delayed up to 15 min. For informational and tracking purposes only.

hero.title: Track Stocks, Multiples & Purchase Variance
hero.sub: Compare current market prices against your personal tracking target. Monitor Current P/E and Forward P/E with zero-latency offline mobile access.
hero.guestHint: Or test right away in Guest Mode below!

watchlist.title: My Watchlist
watchlist.hint: Drag or use arrows to reorder. Tap any ticker to view charts and statistics.
watchlist.emptyBody: Add your first stock or ETF to start tracking current prices, valuation multiples, and target percentage variances.

search.title: Add Stock Ticker
search.sub: Search US stocks, European equities, and ETFs
search.placeholder: Search symbol or name (e.g. AAPL, MC.PA, CW8)...
search.trackingLabel: Tracking Value (Baseline / Cost Basis / Target Buy Price)
search.trackingHint: The % difference shown on your dashboard will be computed against this baseline value.
search.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Bought on dip, long term DCA

account.title: Account Settings
account.sub: Manage your security credentials and profile
account.deleteWarning: Permanently deletes your account, personal watchlist, and all cached data from the server. This action cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account?
